description:
About the Team&Challenge We use AI and multi-source satellites (radar/optical) to map irrigated vs. non-irrigated lands, tackling water scarcity in Egypt. Our automated tool provides real-time data, overcoming cloud cover and reporting delays.

Required Resources & Data: Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2/Landsat, NASA GPM, & labeled datasets (IrrMap). 

Team HydroScan AI: We are CS & AI  engineers fusing satellite data with Deep Learning to map irrigation and solve water scarcity.
